summary: ACME (Dedicated): audit-log-exporter stopped delivering events; missing ~40 min of audit logs
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer reports audit events stopped arriving to SIEM for ~30-40 minutes.
- After restarting exporter, delivery resumed but gap remains.

Impact:
- Customer missing audit log coverage for compliance.

Environment:
- Dedicated deployment.
- Customer-managed webhook endpoint (reported WAF change; may have returned 429s).
- Exporter image tag: audit-log-exporter:v1.9.2

Initial observations:
- Exporter logs show repeated retries after receiving 429 from customer endpoint. Queue depth appears to grow and then gets stuck (suspected wedged retry loop / no drain).

Mitigation:
- Customer performed rolling restart; delivery resumed.

Next steps:
- Reproduce with synthetic 429 / backpressure.
- Confirm whether in-memory queue can drop data under memory pressure.
- Produce customer-facing explanation + recommended config (rate limit / batching).
comments:
2026-02-04 Camila Reyes: Created from #support thread 1770163200. Customer restarted exporter; gap remains.

2026-02-04 Ethan Park: Looking at exporter metrics in dedicated cluster. Queue depth spikes correlate with webhook 429 responses. Hypothesis: retry path blocks dequeue; need circuit breaker / bounded queue.

2026-02-05 Avery Johnson: Suggest hotfix: make retry non-blocking; add max queue + persist-to-disk optional? At minimum, expose `DROP_OLDEST_ON_FULL=true`.

2026-02-06 Ethan Park: Opened PR in audit-log-exporter repo to add bounded queue + exponential backoff + metrics for dropped events. Will link once up.
